player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I stopped the exploration prematurely after returning to the start node, assuming all rooms were visited. I did not check if the set of visited nodes matched the set of all discovered nodes before declaring "DONE". Next time, I will continue moving to unvisited neighbors until no new rooms can be found. Specifically, when I returned to the Media room, I should have checked the available directions (east) and realized I had already visited the Exercise room and Playroom, but I missed that the graph was incomplete or that I needed to explore further if other paths existed. I will ensure to only output "DONE" when the number of unique nodes in my graph equals the number of times I have entered a new room, and I will explicitly verify that no unvisited neighbors remain before stopping.
